intent: Measure whether simple, predeclared end-of-day price/volume signals select next-session and multi-session large movers across the widest entitled US-listed universe, counting every failed signal. Numeric values are predeclared research assumptions, not tuned results. Realized movers are outcomes only; they never define the candidate set.

relation_to_frozen_protocols.catalyst-experiment-v1-20260920: Unchanged and still frozen. Its $1-$50 prior-close band, 8-K Item 1.01 catalyst requirement and $5M liquidity floor answer a different question and would exclude requested names such as META and AMD. None of its filters are applied here and none of its acceptance is rewritten.
relation_to_frozen_protocols.adaptive-paper config.json: Unchanged. Its 24-symbol IEX list is an execution fixture, not this research universe. No numeric risk limit is changed by this protocol.

scope.market: US exchange-listed us_equity symbols present in the provider asset master (active and inactive), excluding OTC and CUSIP-style placeholder symbols, restricted at each decision to symbols with an entitled SIP daily bar on that session
scope.frequency: daily bars; intraday horizons are an unresolved data gate in v1

source_contract.bars: Alpaca market-data v2 /v2/stocks/bars, feed=sip, timeframe=1Day, explicit pagination to a terminal page per symbol group, every page retained with sha256. Two series per symbol: adjustment=raw (prices and volume as traded) and adjustment=all (split/dividend/spin-off adjusted).
source_contract.identity: Bars are requested by the ticker current on the collection date (provider default asof). Renamed issuers appear under the current ticker (FB history is returned as META). A ticker reused after delisting resolves to the current holder; asset-master symbol collisions are counted as an unresolved identity gate, never silently merged or dropped.
source_contract.universe_as_known: The provider exposes no listing/delisting dates or historical security type. Membership on session t is 'has an entitled SIP daily bar on t'. Names the provider never carried are absent; this survivorship exposure is measured by last-bar-year counts of inactive symbols and stays an open gate.
source_contract.availability: Bars downloaded on 2026-09-21 do not prove what was published at each historical close. Later vendor corrections are unknown. v1 assumes a session's daily OHLCV was known after that session's regular close and records this as an assumption, not evidence.
source_contract.raw_vs_adjusted: Eligibility price and dollar volume use raw bars of session t and earlier. Every return and price-ratio feature uses the adjustment=all series so splits and distributions do not create false movers. A (symbol, session) present in one series but not the other is quarantined.
source_contract.calendar: Session order is the sorted set of distinct SIP bar dates of SPY in the dataset; horizons count those sessions.

eligibility.decision_time: after the regular close of session t, using only bars of sessions <= t
eligibility.symbol_exclusion_pattern: Symbols whose dotted suffix is WS, W, U, R or RT (warrants, units, rights) are excluded. Five-letter NASDAQ tickers ending in W, R or U are flagged, not excluded, because the letter convention is ambiguous.

instrument_lanes.primary_operating_company_heuristic: Excludes assets whose CURRENT asset-master name matches ETF|ETN|Fund|Trust|Shares|ProShares|Direxion|iShares|SPDR|Index|Portfolio (case-insensitive). The name is a current attribute, not as-known-then; fund status rarely changes, and the lane is reported beside the unrestricted lane so the heuristic cannot hide a result.

justification.no_price_cap: A cap has no economic basis for a liquid-universe study and would exclude requested large-cap names (META and AMD both trade above $500 on 2026-09-21).
justification.min_close_5: Below $5 a one-cent tick exceeds 20 bps, SIP prints are dominated by odd lots and the SEC penny-stock threshold restricts margin and borrow. Sub-$5 names are studied only in the separate descriptive lane.
justification.min_dollar_volume_20m: Keeps a $200k order under 1% of median daily dollar volume and makes the 5-20 bps per-side cost tiers defensible. Computed only from sessions before t.
justification.min_history_60: The longest feature window (60-session high) must be fully observed; the first 60 sessions after a listing are excluded rather than imputed.

descriptive_microcap_lane.promotion: never; reported for base rates only because most extreme percentage movers live here and quoted data cannot support execution claims

features_at_t.med20: median(dv[t-20..t-1]); requires 20 prior sessions with bars
features_at_t.clv: (raw_close[t] - raw_low[t]) / (raw_high[t] - raw_low[t]); 0.5 when high equals low
features_at_t.range10: (max(all_high[u-9..u]) - min(all_low[u-9..u])) / all_close[u], evaluated at u = t-1
features_at_t.range10_p20: 20th percentile of range10 over u in [t-121, t-2]; requires 120 observations
features_at_t.note: Offsets count the symbol's own consecutive bars; a symbol missing a market session inside a window is flagged has_gap and excluded from that decision.

signals.S1_momentum_breakout: all_close[t] > high60 AND dv >= 2 * med20 AND clv >= 0.75
signals.S2_volume_shock_continuation: r1 >= 0.05 AND dv >= 3 * med20 AND clv >= 0.5
signals.S3_oversold_reversal: r5 <= -0.15 AND raw_close[t] > raw_open[t] AND dv >= med20
signals.S5_gap_and_hold: gap >= 0.04 AND all_close[t] >= all_open[t] AND dv >= 2 * med20

controls.C0_all_eligible: Every eligible (symbol, t) with identical entry, exit and cost mechanics. This is the base rate every signal must beat.
controls.C1_hash_sample: Eligible (symbol, t) where the first 8 hex digits of sha256(symbol + '|' + session_date) as an integer modulo 20 equals 0; a deterministic 5% placebo selection.
controls.market_reference: SPY open[t+1] to the same exit close, reported for context only; SPY is not the strategy universe.

execution_assumptions.entry: Buy at all_open[t+1], the next session's first regular SIP print from the daily bar. The daily bar open is not guaranteed to equal the primary-listing opening auction price; flagged as an assumption.
execution_assumptions.no_entry: No bar on session t+1 means no fill. The event is kept with outcome no_entry and excluded from return means but counted.
execution_assumptions.terminated_early: If the series ends before the exit session, exit at the last available close and flag terminated_early. Stress applies a further -50% to that exit because delisting returns are unknown.
execution_assumptions.fees: Commission-free broker assumed; regulatory fees under 1 bp are inside the tiers.
execution_assumptions.capacity: Order notional assumed <= 1% of med20; reported, not optimised.
execution_assumptions.portfolio: Event-level study. Overlapping events are allowed; inference is clustered by entry date. Per date and signal, top_20 keeps at most 20 events ranked by dv/med20 descending then symbol ascending; all_events keeps every event. Both are reported. No equity curve, leverage, shorting or intraday stop is simulated in v1.

labels_retrospective_only.use: Outcomes for precision, recall, base rate and lift only. Close-to-close label returns are not attainable returns; attainable return starts at the t+1 open. Incomplete horizons are unknown, never zero.

per_signal_horizon_segment_lane_selectio: events, distinct symbols, distinct entry dates, no_entry count, terminated_early count
mean, median, 5th and 95th percentile of net return; share of events with net return <= 0 and their mean loss (failed signals)
date-clustered mean net return and mean net excess over C0 on the same entry date and horizon
moving-block bootstrap confidence interval of the date-level mean excess
label precision, base rate in C0, lift and recall for each retrospective label

chronology.segment_assignment: by decision session t; the reserved end leaves 20 sessions plus margin before the dataset end of 2026-09-18
chronology.trial_policy: Exactly 5 signals x 3 horizons x 2 selections x 2 instrument lanes, all predeclared, plus 2 controls and the descriptive microcap lane. No parameter search. Every variant and segment is reported. Any later variant needs a new protocol version and may not reuse the reserved segment as untouched.
chronology.freeze: This file and evaluate.py are committed before evaluate.py reads real bars. The commit hash is recorded in the results.

before_freeze: Coordinator saw on 2026-09-21: META and AMD SIP daily bars for 2026-09-14..2026-09-21, the provider movers/most-actives screens for 2026-09-21, three AMD bars from January 2016, FB/META/TWTR bar counts for 2022 windows. No historical signal or return statistic was computed.
Earlier programme diagnostics (AAPL 2020, FB/META June 2022, 2021Q1 ETF control, SPY cost scenarios) remain inspected and are not holdouts.
inspection_registry.after_freeze: Every real-data evaluation run appends its date, commit, dataset ledger hash and result hash to the results file.

promotion.scope: Permission to design a separately reviewed paper candidate. Never an automatic order, a limit change or a prediction claim.
requirements: development, validation and reserved each have >= 250 events on >= 100 distinct entry dates
date-clustered mean net excess over C0 > 0 in all three segments with the Bonferroni-adjusted (0.05/15) bootstrap lower bound > 0 in validation and reserved
stress-cost mean net return >= 0 in validation and reserved
identical sign in both instrument lanes
identity, availability and delisting gates either closed or shown not to change the sign under the terminated_early stress
promotion.reject_or_defer: Anything else is reported as not established. A negative result is a result and is kept.

unresolved_gates: historical security type and listing/delisting dates are not available from the entitled source
ticker reuse collisions cannot be resolved without dated identity data
original publication time and later vendor revisions of bars are unknown
opening-auction price, halts and LULD state are not in daily bars
intraday (minute/quote) evaluation across the full universe is not collected in v1
news and filings are not used as features in v1 because their historical availability is unproven
